title: found sound
brief: discovery-focused word game where players unlock new phonemes by creating different words with available letters

details.heading: System Highlight
details.text: integrated CMU Pronouncing Dictionary and sound library for phoneme detection and feedback

details.heading: Design Insight
details.text: one consonant can represent multiple phonemes, enabling exploration and replayability

details.heading: Iteration
details.text: Shifted from rapid guessing to deliberate discovery by introducing negative scoring

details.heading: Feedback
details.text: positive response for progress feedback; next iteration on responsive game balance curve

title: i like the sound of you
brief: romance visual novel where players identify correct phonemic dialogue choices to impress their poetry club crush

details.heading: System Highlight
details.text: Scalable narrative design to align with curriculum and employ level progression

details.heading: Design Insight
details.text: externalized phonemic learning goals by tapping into hi-lo books' reading motivation

details.heading: Iteration
details.text: adapted a DDLC–inspired word selection mini-game to reinforce phoneme choices

details.heading: Feedback
details.text: described as "refreshing & hilarious," opening new directions for educational visual novels

title: phony mystery
brief: detective adventure game where players collect phonemes from environmental clues to solve mysteries

details.heading: System Highlight
details.text: Implemented a complex UI manager that accommodates multiple systems like dialogue and inventory

details.heading: Design Insight
details.text: A clever gameplay loop has limited value if it isn’t intuitive or accessible to players

details.heading: Iteration
details.text: Refactored Unity codebase into modular managers, allowing rapid narrative and content iteration

details.heading: Feedback
details.text: Concept validated as interesting and promising, but confusing in its current form

title: cards against reason
brief: A social card game where players combine phoneme-based cards to build absurd, funny sentences

details.heading: System Highlight
details.text: Similar to Cards Against Humanity, but players can chain multiple response cards in one turn

details.heading: Design Insight
details.text: Humor is the hook, while repeated use of phoneme decks naturally reinforces sound–letter associations

details.heading: Iteration
details.text: Originally a brainstorming tool using permutations of prompts, now shifting toward structured play

details.heading: Feedback
details.text: Highly engaging and educational, though some players may need scaffolding and balance around card use

title: scream phoneme
brief: A voice-controlled platformer where saying 'er' words makes the player jump across buildings

details.heading: System Highlight
details.text: Uses Unity’s Windows Speech Recognition to map audio input with phoneme recognition

details.heading: Design Insight
details.text: Reinforcement through speaking phonemes can enhance learning, coupling with in-game feedback

details.heading: Iteration
details.text: Started with complex multi-phoneme navigation, simplified to single-jump control to test core loop

details.heading: Feedback
details.text: Not yet a fun game but a strong proof-of-concept, needing polish and tighter feedback loops
